rig.notes: Canonical square artwork is placed uniformly at y=256 in a 2:3 portrait. Anatomy coordinates remain in the original 1024-space. Each garment is authored on this mannequin, not a detached item rectangle.

head.notes: Cap crown follows skull/temple curve; brim remains above the eyes. Crown uses a perspective band. Hood rear is below the head; front rim is separately occluded at gill roots and jaw. These are fitting patterns, not released NFT artwork.
head.patternImplementation: Parametric headPattern() in packages/visual-engine/src/anatomy-fit.mjs; contours derive from skull, temple, jaw and neck anchors.

hand.method: Four-corner projective grip registration; 8x12 UV grid. Source camera must match the raised open palm. Fingers are original Pet pixels above the tool.
hand.note: Grip leans toward the raised fingers. Original thumb/finger foreground stays fixed to the Pet; tune rotation per item around palmCenter.
hand.thumbForeground: Only the distal thumb and upper joint are in front of held tools. The rounded thenar/palm base remains on the Pet plane behind the handle.
